newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian retailer TsUM sets 10 rbl 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Russian retailer TsUM sets 10 rbl 1996 dividend.

text.p: Russian retailer TsUM approved a 10 rouble dividend on ordinary shares with a face value of 1,000 roubles at its annual meeting, TsUM financial consultants OLMA said on Friday.
OLMA said OAO TsUM posted revenues of 227 billion roubles in 1996, up 33 percent on 1995 revenues, while net profit was down to 12.00 billion roubles. Net profit was 13.47 billion roubles in 1995.
The investment company said shareholders also appointed representatives of the AIG Brunswick investment funds in the U.S. and the Bahamas to the company's board of directors.
The Moscow government, Brunswick, Swiss private bank Pictet and Russian SBS-Agro bank are among TsUM's biggest investors, OLMA said.
